title: Swords and sandals
blurb: Hercules, Maciste and every muscleman Italy could find, in the Technicolor epics of the early 60s. Cardboard columns, real biceps.

films.note: Sergio Leone's first film as director, years before the westerns.
Mario Bava directs, and Christopher Lee rules the underworld.
Steve Reeves again, in the sequel to the film that started the craze.
A muscleman against the scientists of Atlantis. Science fiction in sandals.
